name: Email
description: Hand the mail you allow to the tasks you connect, and let them reply, send and file email from your mailbox.

disclosure: Octopus signs in to your mailbox over an encrypted connection with an app password that stays on this computer.
Only new mail from your own address and the senders you allow reaches your tasks; everything else stays where it is.
Connected tasks can send, reply, forward, flag and move mail as you, and every send is recorded.
Disconnect at any time to remove the saved address and password.

fields.label: App password
fields.help: For Gmail, create an app password in your Google account

fields.label: IMAP server
fields.help: Leave empty for Gmail, iCloud, Outlook.com, Yahoo, Yandex, Mail.ru and Fastmail.

fields.label: SMTP server
fields.help: Port 465 uses TLS from the start and 587 switches to TLS with STARTTLS. Leave empty for the built-in providers.

fields.label: Allowed senders
fields.help: Your own address is always allowed. The first address listed also receives new messages by default.
